title: Handling things under pressure
focus: 负责、处理、关键、压力、机会、能力、经验、甚至
body:
# Handling things under pressure

Words for taking charge when things are hard: who's responsible, what matters, and whether you can cope.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 负责 | fùzé | to be in charge of / responsible for | bear the duty → in charge |
| 处理 | chǔlǐ | to handle / deal with (a problem, a task) | handle and put in order |
| 关键 | guānjiàn | key / crucial point | bolt that locks the gate |
| 压力 | yālì | pressure / stress | pressing force → pressure |
| 机会 | jīhuì | opportunity / chance | moment things come together |
| 能力 | nénglì | ability / capability | strength to do → ability |
| 经验 | jīngyàn | experience (know-how gained over time) | tested by going through it |
| 甚至 | shènzhì | even (going so far as) | go to the extreme → even |

## Which word?

**负责 vs 责任 (L2).** 负责 is the verb, be in charge of (我负责这个). 责任 is the noun, responsibility (责任在我).

**处理 vs 解决 (L2).** 处理 means you deal with it. 解决 means it is actually solved.

## Sentences

- 他甚至连一次机会都不给我。 tā shènzhì lián yí cì jīhuì dōu bù gěi wǒ: He wouldn't even give me a single chance.
- 关键是先找到原因，再处理。 guānjiàn shì xiān zhǎodào yuányīn, zài chǔlǐ: The key is to find the cause first, then deal with it.
- 最近压力太大，甚至影响睡眠。 zuìjìn yālì tài dà, shènzhì yǐngxiǎng shuìmián: I've been so stressed lately that it's even affecting my sleep.
- 关键是能力，经验可以慢慢学。 guānjiàn shì nénglì, jīngyàn kěyǐ mànmàn xué: The key thing is ability. Experience comes with time.
- 我建议你别错过这个机会。 wǒ jiànyì nǐ bié cuòguò zhège jīhuì: I suggest you don't pass up this chance.
- 这事是我负责的，责任在我。 zhè shì shì wǒ fùzé de, zérèn zài wǒ: I was in charge of this, so the responsibility is mine.
- 说实话，他处理问题很有经验。 shuō shíhuà, tā chǔlǐ wèntí hěn yǒu jīngyàn: Honestly, he's very experienced at handling problems.
- 估计他压力也很大，何必怪他呢？ gūjì tā yālì yě hěn dà, hébì guài tā ne: He's probably under a lot of pressure too. Why blame him?

cards.English: to be in charge of / responsible for
cards.Example: 这个项目由小王负责。 zhège xiàngmù yóu Xiǎo Wáng fùzé: Xiao Wang is in charge of this project
cards.Notes: 负 fù carry on the back, bear (负担) + 责 zé duty, blame (责任) = bear the duty, so be responsible / in charge. 负责人 = person in charge. 对…负责 = be accountable for.

cards.English: to handle / deal with (a problem, a task)
cards.Example: 这件事我来处理。 zhè jiàn shì wǒ lái chǔlǐ: I'll handle this
cards.Notes: 处 chǔ deal with, get along (相处; chù in 到处) + 理 lǐ put in order (整理, 管理) = handle and put in order, so deal with a problem or task. 处理 = deal with it; 解决 = actually solve it.

cards.Example: 关键是你自己想不想做。 guānjiàn shì nǐ zìjǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng zuò: The key thing is whether you actually want to do it
cards.Notes: 关 guān gate, shut (关门, 海关) + 键 jiàn bolt, key, 钅 metal (键盘 keyboard) = the bolt that locks the gate, the crucial point. 关键是…… is a very common way to start a sentence.

cards.Example: 压力太大了，我晚上都睡不着。 yālì tài dà le, wǒ wǎnshang dōu shuì bu zháo: I'm so stressed I can't sleep at night
cards.Notes: 压 yā press (血压 blood pressure) + 力 lì force (力气, 能力) = pressing force, exactly 'pressure'. 压力大 = stressed; 减压 = reduce pressure, de-stress

cards.Example: 这是个难得的机会，你别错过。 zhè shì ge nándé de jīhuì, nǐ bié cuòguò: This is a rare opportunity, don't miss it
cards.Notes: 机 jī critical moment (时机, 危机 crisis; also machine, 手机) + 会 huì occasion, meeting (会议, 聚会) = the moment when things come together. 机遇 (遇 encounter, 遇到) is more formal and bigger, like a historic opportunity.

cards.Example: 她能力很强，什么都能搞定。 tā nénglì hěn qiáng, shénme dōu néng gǎodìng: She's very capable, she can handle anything
cards.Notes: 能 néng can, able (能不能, 可能) + 力 lì strength (力气, 努力) = strength to do. 本事 is the colloquial equivalent: 他有本事.

cards.Example: 他没什么工作经验。 tā méi shénme gōngzuò jīngyàn: He doesn't have much work experience
cards.Notes: 经 jīng pass through (经过, 已经) + 验 yàn test, check (检验, 验血) = tested by going through it. 经验 = skill or lessons learned; 经历 (历 go through, 历史) = things you went through.

cards.Example: 他忙得甚至没时间吃饭。 tā máng de shènzhì méi shíjiān chīfàn: He's so busy he doesn't even have time to eat
cards.Notes: 甚 shèn extremely (classical 很; old 甚么 = 什么) + 至 zhì reach (至少) = going to the extreme: even. Often 甚至……都/也…….

cards.English: He wouldn't even give me a single chance.
cards.Hanzi: 他甚至连一次机会都不给我。
cards.Pinyin: tā shènzhì lián yí cì jīhuì dōu bù gěi wǒ.
cards.Notes: 甚至 (L4) + 机会 (L4). 甚至连……都…… = 'even'.

cards.English: The key is to find the cause first, then deal with it.
cards.Hanzi: 关键是先找到原因，再处理。
cards.Pinyin: guānjiàn shì xiān zhǎodào yuányīn, zài chǔlǐ.
cards.Notes: 关键 (L4) + 处理 (L4) + 原因 (L2). 再 = 'then / at that point', not 'again'.

cards.English: I've been so stressed lately that it's even affecting my sleep.
cards.Hanzi: 最近压力太大，甚至影响睡眠。
cards.Pinyin: zuìjìn yālì tài dà, shènzhì yǐngxiǎng shuìmián.
cards.Notes: 压力 (L4) + 甚至 (L4) + 影响 (L2).

cards.English: The key thing is ability. Experience comes with time.
cards.Hanzi: 关键是能力，经验可以慢慢学。
cards.Pinyin: guānjiàn shì nénglì, jīngyàn kěyǐ mànmàn xué.
cards.Notes: 关键 (L4) + 能力 (L4) + 经验 (L4).

cards.English: I suggest you don't pass up this chance.
cards.Hanzi: 我建议你别错过这个机会。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ jiànyì nǐ bié cuòguò zhège jīhuì.

cards.English: I was in charge of this, so the responsibility is mine.
cards.Hanzi: 这事是我负责的，责任在我。
cards.Pinyin: zhè shì shì wǒ fùzé de, zérèn zài wǒ.
cards.Notes: 负责 (L4) + 责任 (L2). 负责 is the verb, 责任 the noun.

cards.English: Honestly, he's very experienced at handling problems.
cards.Hanzi: 说实话，他处理问题很有经验。
cards.Pinyin: shuō shíhuà, tā chǔlǐ wèntí hěn yǒu jīngyàn.
cards.Notes: 处理 (L4) + 经验 (L4) + 说实话 (L1).

cards.English: He's probably under a lot of pressure too. Why blame him?
cards.Hanzi: 估计他压力也很大，何必怪他呢？
cards.Pinyin: gūjì tā yālì yě hěn dà, hébì guài tā ne?
cards.Notes: 压力 (L4) + 估计 (L3) + 何必 (L3).
